title: Magical Bali Holiday with Flights
alt: Kelingking beach on Nusa Penida, Bali
transport: Return flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small villa property on the quiet edge of Ubud

activities.name: Kintamani with the jungle swing
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting, the Tegalalang rice terraces, Tegenungan waterfall and a turn on the jungle swing, with lunch included along the way.

activities.name: Ubud art market
activities.description: Two floors of carvings, batik, woven bags and silver, best in the early morning when the stalls open and the prices are softest.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights inland to start, with a coffee plantation road up to Kintamani, the rice terraces at Tegalalang and a waterfall stop.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Tanah Lot and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large pool hotel ten minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Temple tour with Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: Taman Ayun, the Alas Kedaton monkey forest and the lake temple at Beratan, finishing with sunset at the sea temple of Tanah Lot.

activities.name: Water sports and Uluwatu temple
activities.description: Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing at Tanjung Benoa in the morning, then the cliff top temple at Uluwatu in the late afternoon.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast by speedboat
activities.description: Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach, the island's four most photographed stops.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the south coast, with a temple day that ends at Tanah Lot, water sports at Tanjung Benoa and a full day on Nusa Penida.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud villa and unwind
Evening free among the rice fields
Optional: the Ubud art market or Goa Gajah cave temple
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegalalang rice terraces and Tegenungan waterfall
A turn on the jungle swing, with lunch included
3: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer towards Kuta
Taman Ayun temple and the Alas Kedaton monkey forest
Lake Beratan, then sunset at the sea temple of Tanah Lot
Check in at your Kuta hotel for the next three nights
4: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing at the water sports club
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs in the late afternoon
5: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach
Return boat to Bali and back to your hotel
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your return flight

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Six days is enough for Bali if you split them. Two nights inland, three on the coast, one big island day.
expert.tip: Nusa Penida days start early because the sea is calmest before noon. Carry flat shoes for the Kelingking steps, keep a dry bag for your phone, and plan a slow evening afterwards.

summary: A short Bali holiday with return flights built in. Two nights in Ubud for the rice terraces and Kintamani, then three on the south coast with a temple day at Tanah Lot, water sports at Tanjung Benoa and a full day on Nusa Penida.
included: Included: return international flights; 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and jungle swing tour with lunch; temple tour with Tanah Lot sunset; water sports with Uluwatu; Nusa Penida west coast tour; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners other than the one stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
